build_notes.reason: VYROX must not compile an absolute /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/libexec/proot loader path. Keep the loader embedded until a VYROX-specific relocation strategy is verified.
build_notes.required_ndk: Android NDK with AArch64 Android/Bionic target
build_notes.note: Termux package build recipes are a reference. They do not by themselves produce a VYROX-compatible binary or resolve VYROX's separate package prefix.
build_notes.loader_strategy: Build the PRoot loader as a separate static AArch64 ELF packaged as libproot-loader.so. At runtime set PROOT_LOADER to that file beside libproot.so under applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir.
build_notes.talloc_build_strategy: Build talloc 2.4.2 as a PIC static archive and link it into the PRoot executable. Do not package libtalloc.so.
build_notes.shared_memory_build_strategy: Build libandroid-shmem 0.7 as a PIC static archive and link it into PRoot with libandroid and liblog. Do not package libandroid-shmem.so.

components.role: Android/Bionic PRoot process and filesystem redirection; runtime loader is a separate static executable
PRoot hierarchical memory allocation dependency, statically linked into PRoot
components.notes: The pinned Termux 2.4.2 recipe records this source archive digest and creates libtalloc.a from its PIC objects. The Termux package label is GPL-3.0 while the talloc library source carries LGPL terms; preserve both notice files and review before redistribution.
components.packaging_strategy: Static PIC archive linked into the PRoot PIE; no standalone libtalloc shared object is packaged.

components.role: Android shared-memory compatibility for PRoot, statically linked
components.packaging_strategy: Static PIC archive linked into PRoot; no standalone libandroid-shmem.so is packaged.
